name: Dependency Update Check
description: Check RemoteJuggler's Go dependencies for available updates. Search the web for changelogs of any outdated deps. If updates are safe (no breaking changes), create a PR bumping them.
process: Read go.mod files via github_fetch for gateway/, deploy/adapters/, test/campaigns/runner/
Use web_search to find latest versions of key dependencies (especially tailscale.com)
Use web_fetch to read changelogs or release notes if updates are available
If updates are safe, create a branch and PR with version bumps

metrics.successCriteria: Dependency audit completed with web research, PR created if updates found
